race.comment: Ignore the fact THE DESTROYER (11) ran 9th, beaten more than 11 lengths on debut because that was in a slick city race won by star filly Natural Fling. Was backed from $51 into $26 that day, so had obviously shown something, and has trialled well twice this time in. Respect in this much more suitable contest. SKJALDMO (5) is back after a break of 11 months. Went close to a maiden win before the layoff, finishing third at her latest appearance over 1200m at Cranbourne. Placed in a recent trial. Ready for a bold run. ENGULF (10) just stretched the legs in the first trial, but was better at trial No 2 and is from a stable who can produce a debut winner so keep an eye on the market. MERITORIOUS (7) was also an improver at latest trial and a big debut showing would not shock.
